CODE
Art. 2.3.52. 
Authorised derogations
Spouses who have adopted a community regime may not derogate from the rules of the legal regime concerning the management of their own and their joint assets. Subject to the provisions of articles 2.3.1 to 2.3.3, they may, by matrimonial agreement, make any other modification to the legal regime.   
In particular, they may agree: 
1¡ that the joint patrimony shall comprise all or part of their present and future property; 
2¡ that there shall be universal community between them; 
3¡ that one of the spouses shall be entitled to a preciput (i.e., ; a portion of an estate which is to be taken out before the partition is made).
4¡ that in the event of dissolution of the marriage by the death of one of the spouses, the joint patrimony shall be divided in unequal shares or that all the patrimony shall be attributed to one of the spouses.
They remain subject to the rules of the legal system from which their matrimonial agreement does not derogate.
